tools.name: extract
tools.description: Fetch any public web page URL and get clean, LLM-ready text or Markdown: main content, code blocks, tables, links and headings, for RAG and agent context. Static HTML, Markdown or text; optional section ID. Default 20,000 output characters, max 100,000; input 2 MiB. No JavaScript rendering (see /extract/rendered), logins or paywalls. Empty pages, bad sections, browser challenges and errors are not charged. Use to read docs or articles. Example: url=https://example.com. Price $0.002/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the page to fetch

maxChars.description: Maximum characters of body text to return (500-100000, default 20000)

format.description: Returned representation: text (default), markdown, or both. HTML structured details are included in every format; Markdown/plain sources have empty details.

section.description: Optional exact visible HTML ID within primary content, 1-500 characters. Heading scope includes subsections until next same/higher-level heading; section/article/main/div scope is its subtree. Missing/ambiguous/unsupported targets fail uncharged. URL fragments alone do not select a section.

sourceMetadata.description: Page-level source declarations, not verified authorship or freshness. Head author/Open Graph date tags and bounded direct Schema.org JSON-LD Article/WebPage-like nodes only; exact-URL matches preferred, otherwise only one identity-free candidate. Author @id references resolve only to unambiguous local Person/Organization names, with both paths recorded. No external context/reference fetching or general JSON-LD expansion. Separate 2000-character value+provenance budget; 5 authors/10 dates. Original date strings are not normalized. Empty for Markdown/plain sources; unrelated entities and ambiguous nodes are omitted with warnings.

linkBaseUrl.description: Effective source-derived HTTP(S) base for links: the first supported HTML base href outside inert/foreign subtrees, otherwise finalUrl. Credentials and non-HTTP(S) base values are ignored with a warning. HTML links/canonical use this base; raw Markdown keeps relative syntax and can be resolved using this field. No linked resource is fetched. This static interpretation does not evaluate scripts or Content Security Policy.

sourceFormat.description: Source interpretation. Markdown is identified by text/markdown, or a .md/.markdown final path served as text/plain (warned). Markdown syntax is retained verbatim within the cap, not converted to HTML or parsed for structured details; text also retains that syntax. HTML section IDs are unsupported for Markdown/plain text.

textLength.description: Full extracted text length before the character cap, within the input limit.

truncated.description: Input or requested primary representation is incomplete. Structured detail limits are reported separately in warnings.

id.description: Source HTML heading ID or direct child anchor ID, when present and supported; not a generated slug.

section.description: Null for full primary-content reading. Otherwise the explicitly requested scope; title/description/canonical remain page-level metadata. Heading scope ends before the next same/higher-level heading, including nested subsections; container scope is its subtree.

tools.name: sitemap
tools.description: Read one public XML sitemap or sitemap index as structured URLs and source-reported dates. Supports gzip, substring filtering and pagination. Larger sitemaps are read from the start: the first 512 KiB and at most 1000 entries, with a warning. Does not crawl pages or follow child sitemaps. Invalid XML and execution errors are not charged; a valid empty match is charged. Use to find which pages of a docs site to read before calling /extract. Example: url=https://www.sitemaps.org/sitemap.xml. Price $0.002/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

url.description: Absolute public HTTP(S) XML sitemap URL; child sitemaps are not fetched automatically

contains.description: Optional case-insensitive URL substring, at most 200 characters

maxUrls.description: Reported matching locations examined in one page (1-100, default 25); invalid/nonpublic locations may reduce returned entries

offset.description: Offset into distinct reported matching locations (0-1000, default 0); use nextOffset to continue

lastModified.description: Source-reported value; not a verified modification time.

matchingReportedLocations.description: Distinct reported locations matching contains, before public-URL validation of the selected page.

tools.name: domain
tools.description: Domain intelligence in one call: DNS records (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, TXT, CAA), DNSSEC status, registrar, registration and expiry dates with domain age in days (RDAP/WHOIS), and email authentication (SPF and DMARC records and policies, whether the domain accepts mail). Use for lead qualification, phishing and trust checks, and deliverability audits. For a trust verdict with named flags use domain_report. Example: name=cloudflare.com. Price $0.005/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

tools.name: domain_report
tools.description: A trust verdict for any domain in one call: high/medium/low trust with named flags for very new registrations, expiry, missing or weak SPF and DMARC, too few nameservers, no web host and non-resolving domains, plus the key facts (registrar, age, nameservers, DNSSEC). Use for lead qualification, phishing and vendor checks, and before an agent sends mail to or trusts a domain. Signals only, not a guarantee. Raw DNS records: domain. Example: name=cloudflare.com. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

Use for token due diligence and rug-pull or honeypot screening before a swap. Example: address=0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

Heuristic screening, not a safety guarantee. Use before swapping into an unfamiliar Base token. Example: address=0x4200000000000000000000000000000000000006. tools.name: arb_proxy

tools.name: arb_call

Use to read any view function that has no dedicated tool (the example reads USDC totalSupply, selector 0x18160ddd); decode the result with the function's ABI. Calldata up to 8 KB; a call that reverts is 422 with the reason, uncharged. Example: to=0x09Bc4E0D864854c6aFB6eB9A9cdF58aC190D0dF9, data=0x18160ddd. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

data.description: 0x ABI-encoded calldata: 4-byte selector plus arguments

from.description: Optional 0x sender address for calls that check msg.sender

tools.name: mantle_estimate_gas
tools.description: Estimate the gas a transaction would use on Mantle (eth_estimateGas) and what it would cost at the current gas price, in gas units, gwei and MNT. Give to, plus value in MNT and calldata for a contract call, and the sender when the call depends on it. Use before sending a transaction or to price a batch; for the gas price alone use mantle_gas. A transaction that would revert is 422 with the reason, uncharged. Example: to=0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

value.description: Amount of MNT to send, in MNT (default 0)

data.description: Optional 0x calldata for a contract call

tools.name: mantle_gas_history
tools.description: Gas price history on Mantle (eth_feeHistory): base fee in gwei for each of the last N blocks (5-100, default 20), how full each block was, and the 10th, 50th and 90th percentile priority fees, with the low, average and high base fee over the window. Use to judge whether fees are rising, pick a priority fee or time a transaction; for the current price alone use mantle_gas. Example: blocks=20. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

blocks.description: How many recent blocks, 5-100 (default 20)

tools.name: mantle_allowance
tools.description: ERC-20 token allowance on Mantle: how much a spender may move from an owner's wallet (allowance), raw and in token units, and whether the approval is unlimited. Use to check an approval before a swap or to audit risky open approvals; for the owner's balance use mantle_token_balance. Token is a ticker (USDC, USDT, WETH…) or a 0x contract; a missing contract is 404 and a non-ERC-20 422, both uncharged. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

token.description: Token: a ticker such as USDC or WETH, or the 0x ERC-20 contract address

spender.description: 0x contract or wallet allowed to spend (the example is Uniswap Permit2)

tools.name: celo_balance
tools.description: Native CELO balance (eth_getBalance) of any 0x wallet address on Celo at the latest block, in wei and in CELO. Use to check whether a wallet can pay gas or a transfer; for ERC-20 tokens use celo_token_balance, for all holdings at once use wallet_portfolio. A malformed address is rejected with 400, uncharged. Example: address=0xd8dA6BF26964aF9D7eEd9e03E53415D37aA96045. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

tools.name: celo_token_balance
tools.description: ERC-20 token balance of a wallet on Celo (USDC, USDT, WETH or any token, via balanceOf): raw amount, decimals, symbol and the human-readable amount, live from the token contract. Use to check stablecoin or token holdings before a transfer or trade; for the native coin use celo_balance. Both inputs are 0x addresses (40 hex characters); no contract returns 404 and a non-ERC-20 contract 422, both uncharged. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

token.description: Token: a ticker such as USDC, USDT, WETH or DAI, or the 0x ERC-20 contract address

tools.name: celo_token_info
tools.description: Look up the name, symbol, decimals and total supply of an ERC-20 token contract on Celo, live from the contract. Use to identify an unknown token address or to format raw amounts; for a holder's balance use celo_token_balance. Input is a ticker (USDC, WETH…) or the token's 0x contract address; an address that is not an ERC-20 contract returns 422, uncharged. Example: token=0xcebA9300f2b948710d2653dD7B07f33A8B32118C. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

token.description: Token: a ticker such as USDC or WETH, or the 0x ERC-20 contract address

tools.name: celo_block
tools.description: Latest block number and block details on Celo, or any block by decimal number: hash, timestamp, transaction count, gas used and limit, base fee in gwei and producer. Use for timestamps and confirmation counts; for current fees use celo_gas. A block that does not exist yet returns 404, uncharged. Example: number=latest. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

tools.name: celo_gas

Use before sending a transaction or to decide whether to wait; for the fee a past transaction actually paid use celo_receipt. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

only.description: Optional: comma-separated top-level result keys to keep, for a smaller answer (for example only=price,symbol); unknown keys are ignored and an empty match returns the full result

tools.name: celo_tx
tools.description: Look up a Celo transaction by hash: sender, recipient, value in CELO, nonce, gas limit, the 4-byte function selector and its block. Use to see what was sent or whether it exists; for success or failure and fees paid use celo_receipt, for emitted events celo_logs. Input is a 0x-prefixed 64-hex hash; an unknown hash returns 404, uncharged. Example: hash=0xc6a38b860427aa5bd7f65f8a879a7d369e77b3767200c68cde4002014ad50444. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

tools.name: celo_receipt
tools.description: Transaction receipt on Celo (eth_getTransactionReceipt): success or reverted, gas used, effective gas price, fee paid in CELO, number of event logs and any contract created. Use to confirm a payment or call went through; for sender, value and calldata use celo_tx. Input is a 0x-prefixed 64-hex hash; a pending or unknown hash returns 404, uncharged. Example: hash=0xc6a38b860427aa5bd7f65f8a879a7d369e77b3767200c68cde4002014ad50444. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

tools.name: celo_nonce
tools.description: Read the transaction count (nonce) of a 0x address on Celo, both confirmed and including pending transactions. Use to build the next transaction or to tell whether an address has ever sent anything; for its balance use celo_balance. A malformed address is rejected with 400, uncharged. Example: address=0xd8dA6BF26964aF9D7eEd9e03E53415D37aA96045. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

tools.name: celo_is_contract

Example: address=0xcebA9300f2b948710d2653dD7B07f33A8B32118C. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

tools.name: celo_logs
tools.description: Recent contract event logs on Celo (eth_getLogs): the events a contract emitted over the last N blocks (1-1,000, default 50), optionally filtered by topic0 (the 0x 32-byte event signature hash). Returns up to 100 logs with block, transaction hash and topics. Use to watch transfers or contract events; for one transaction's outcome use celo_receipt. Example: address=0xcebA9300f2b948710d2653dD7B07f33A8B32118C. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

blocks.description: How many recent blocks to scan (1-1000, default 50)

topic0.description: Optional 0x event signature hash to filter by
